answer: Sybil farmers cannot mint cheap clones: every new identity must arrive with a bonded sponsor. A sponsor locks 200 credits per identity and backs at most 20, keeping endorsements scarce. A sponsored identity proven fake costs its sponsor bond plus reputation, leaving it hollow. Idle identities decay 5% per epoch, so dormant sock-puppets rot. The fable of costless identity dies: forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 200 = 200,000 locked credits plus slashing risk, linear and unrecoverable. An honest agent pays one bond, keeps it active, and earns a pearl of trust clones cannot dilute.
